correctness.rationale: PASS: Minkowski additivity identifies direction width as sum of Gaussian k-point coordinate ranges divided by Gaussian radius. For complete k-uniform hypergraph the nondegenerate first Hoeffding projection yields a sqrt(n) Gaussian CLT; radius expansion and Gaussian integration-by-parts produce corrected variance k^2 Var(F_k(Z))-mu_k^2/2. For fixed-hub k-uniform star conditional LLN yields nonconstant F_k(Z), hence a non-Gaussian limit without CLT scaling. Finite-n expectation equals mu_k sqrt(n)/E chi_{n+1}. Lower-edge square-root and positive folded-Gaussian tail follow from F_k even with positive second derivative at zero. Independent high-precision quadrature reproduced k=4 mu=2.0587507460, Var(F4)=0.134056689748 and tau4²=0.025679718878.
residual_risks: Claim fixed k>=3 for hub non-Gaussian limit, and n→infinity; not all-subset star or k growing with n.
